m2_definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Iran Post assignment release, complete for its declared source, jurisdiction and time scope, preserves ten-digit strings, separates five-digit forwarding context and non-postcode P.O. Box/poste restante objects, and is reproducibly transformed and fully validated into immutable published data verified by the AGID loader/API. GNAF and certificates require exact operational display/retention rights; any geometry or civic-address/building relation has independent authority, licence, validity and lineage. No guaranteed polygons, universal coverage, household identities or sovereignty claims are inferred.

definition_basis: The existing IR manifest had no named M2 stage. This country-specific criterion formalizes its ten-digit place identifiers, non-area geometry, five-digit routing context, P.O. Box/poste restante exceptions, GNAF/certificate privacy, temporal and jurisdiction rules. All nine existing hard blockers and M1_metadata status remain unchanged.

reference_probes.role: government-context-only; observed HTTPS redirect to iransdi.ncc.gov.ir, not postal authority
dated-format-reference-only; a newly reachable PDF requires separate complete review and digest pinning

cache_context.channel: search-service extracted PDF copy, two pages
cache_context.observed_semantics: Ten-digit format; P.O. Box and poste restante addresses omit the postcode. This retains the existing contract, not a current assignment release.

quality_rules: The assignment grain is source edition/jurisdiction/postal object/validity, not the code alone. Preserve ten-digit string identity and source-specific object types; five-digit forwarding context is not an exact area.

For real inputs measure completeness, object-type coverage, temporal validity, duplicate composite keys, syntax and source-to-output reconciliation. With zero acquired assignment rows, quality rates are null, not 0% errors.
A timeout, HTTP error, redirect or search-index copy proves neither absence of a national dataset nor a licence grant/ban. Record exactly which entry point and transport were checked.
Only allowlisted HTTPS reference GETs are made. No private GNAF lookup, code/coordinate query, certificate request, account, credential, payment, contract or personal-data endpoint is used.
Hash only successfully acquired response bytes. Non-200 error bodies are cancelled and not hashed as source evidence. A PDF signature alone is not a reviewed document or current data.

Source version, validity, observed/retrieved time and supersession remain independent. No address/building relation, official polygon, derived surface, virtual region or AGID crosswalk is generated from these references.
